title: $Rp_*$ on $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,E)$ is a left adjoint for proper $p$
statement:
Let $E$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, let $\Lambda=\underline E$
([sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]), and let $p\colon Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of the setting. Then
the derived pushforward $Rp_*\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Z,\underline E)\to D_{\mathrm{cons}}(Y,\underline E)$
of [def-sfb-dc-lower-star] has a right adjoint $Rp^!$.

external.place: This is the existence of the exceptional inverse image for $\ell$-adic sheaves (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8).
This is the existence of the exceptional inverse image for $\ell$-adic sheaves (Bhatt–Scholze, §6.8).
On each torsion level $\cO_E/\varpi^n$, in which $p$ is invertible, the étale $Rp_*=Rp_!$ has a right adjoint $Rp^!$ (SGA 4, XVIII).
It preserves bounded constructible complexes by Deligne's finiteness theorem (SGA 4½, *Th. finitude*), and it is compatible with reduction modulo $\varpi^n$.

proof.text: The finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is an admissible rational coefficient in the list of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. The schemes $Z,Y$ and the proper $k$-morphism $p$ satisfy the standing hypotheses of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: separated and of finite type over $k$, with $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$. Apply [det-cor-existence-ii-restriction] (2) to this coefficient and morphism, renaming its $X$ as $Z$. It supplies a functor $p^!\colon\Dctf(Y,E)\to\Dctf(Z,E)$ and a natural adjunction bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(Rp_*K,L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(K,p^!L)$ for $K\in\Dctf(Z,E)$ and $L\in\Dctf(Y,E)$.

The coefficient $E$ in step 1 denotes the condensed ring $\underline E$, defined by $S\mapsto C(S,E)$ with the $\ell$-adic topology in [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. This is the condensed-module convention of [sk-def-sfb-constructible], whose $\Dbc(-,E)$ is the full subcategory with bounded constructible cohomology over the pulled-back ring. For this rational coefficient [sk-def-localizing-closure] states $\Dctf(-,E)=\Dbc(-,E)$, while [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting] defines $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(-,\underline E)$ as that same bounded constructible category of modules over the pulled-back condensed ring. Finally [def-sfb-dc-lower-star] defines the target's $Rp_*$ as the restriction of the ambient derived pushforward. Consequently the categories and left functor in step 1 are precisely those in the statement. Define $Rp^!$ to be its $p^!$. The displayed Hom bijection of step 1, with the same objects and morphisms, is natural in both variables and proves $Rp_*\dashv Rp^!$. No comparison with a discrete constant $E$-sheaf or with a rationalized étale category is being used.
